641:t_014:38.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「If a god is one whose power exceeds human understanding, then higher-dimensional life-forms would qualify from present humanity's perspective.」

641:t_014:39.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But $$テンプティ$$ and the others aren't gods. We're nothing so grand.」

641:t_014:40.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Conceited fools who think they're gods are just trite and ridiculous.」

641:t_014:41.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We are $$御使い$$s... those who serve God... God is none other than the Supreme God.」

641:t_014:43.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「So you haven't changed. Not since that day 120 million years ago...!」

641:t_014:44.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「These are... $$サイデリアル$$'s rulers...」

641:t_014:45.en:
$$バナージ$$
「These are the angels $$サイアム・ビスト$$ saw at $$ラプラス$$!」

641:t_014:46.en:
$$シャア$$
「The $$御使い$$s... They are the ones monitoring humanity's evolution...」

641:t_014:47.en:
$$葵$$
「Does that mean they're the ones who destroyed $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s planet, too!?」

641:t_014:48.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「We spared the $$ジェミナイド$$s because they could be useful as soldiers.」

641:t_014:49.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「But you refused to submit to $$サイデリアル$$. It is too late to beg for forgiveness now.」

641:t_014:50.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「The Earth species is dangerous, after all. We were going to erase you regardless of your answer.」

641:t_014:51.en:
$$ランド$$
「They destroyed the Earth $$バルビエル$$ came from, too!?」

641:t_014:52.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「That's right. We kept that boy as a pet because he had his uses.」

641:t_014:53.en:
$$赤木$$
「$$ティティ$$! If you have that kind of power, why were you with $c!?」

641:t_014:54.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Isn't it obvious? It looked fun.」

641:t_014:56.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$テンプティ$$ governs the emotion of 'pleasure.'」

641:t_014:57.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「The Earth species kept resisting $$サイデリアル$$... And one of you even had the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$. I couldn't just leave you alone.」

641:t_014:58.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So you know about the $$スフィア$$s, too.」

641:t_014:59.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Naturally. They belong to us.」

641:t_014:60.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「In other words, all $$スフィア・リアクター$$s are our possessions.」

641:t_014:62.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You understand, don't you, $$アウストラリス$$? Just how sinful it is to run off with them?」

641:t_014:64.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「And cheating to break the restrictions we imposed and gather four $$スフィア$$s is unforgivable.」

641:t_014:67.en:
$n
「That story about your father and brother dying, and your mother resenting you... Was that...」

641:t_014:68.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Of course it was a lie. I tried giving myself a backstory that would interest you, $n. How was it?」

641:t_014:70.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Are you angry after all?」

641:t_014:72.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You keep quiet. I'm talking to $n.」

641:t_014:73.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So being acknowledged by people like these... was what happiness meant to $$バルビエル$$...」

641:t_014:74.en:
$$セツコ$$
「They destroyed his Earth, and he hated everything... Yet he still tried to cling to their power...」

641:t_014:75.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「This is not limited to $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$. All $$スフィア・リアクター$$s are destined to serve us.」

641:t_014:76.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「So come to $$テンプティ$$, $n.」

641:t_014:77.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Now that $$エルーナルーナ$$ is dead, I'll make you my favorite.」

641:t_014:78.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Be quiet! After deceiving $n, you have no right to...」

641:t_014:83.en:
$n
「So there never was a $$ティティ$$ with a tragic past who lost her life in battle...」

641:t_014:84.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You aren't bitter? You aren't angry?」

641:t_014:86.en:
$n
「Besides... if I were, I'd only be entertaining you.」

641:t_014:88.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I just can't get enough of that positive attitude of yours!」

641:t_014:89.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「I commend your resolve in overcoming all of that, $$アムブリエル・ジ・オーバーライザー$$.」

641:t_014:91.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$ハマリエル・ザ・スター$$...」

641:t_014:93.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$ウェルキエル・ザ・ヒート$$...」

641:t_014:95.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$ズリエル・ジ・アンブレイカブル$$...」

641:t_014:97.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Come to us with your $$スフィア$$s.」

641:t_014:98.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「That'll give us eight $$スフィア$$s. Then all we'll need are the four that one has.」

641:t_015:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You must not harm them.」

641:t_015:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「No... $n... You cannot harm them.」

641:t_016:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Is this your doing!?」

641:t_016:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Weak beings who come into contact with this power have their souls stolen and their minds torn apart.」

641:t_016:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「It's been a while, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. I heard you were here, so $$テンプティ$$ came to this world, too.」

641:t_016:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Has it been 12,000 years...? We are pleased you answered our call.」

641:t_016:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The great collapse that comes once every 120 million years is approaching... I merely judged that this was no time to remain trapped in the past.」

641:t_016:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! What on earth are you...!?」

641:t_016:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I am $$喜びのアドヴェント$$. The last of the $$御使い$$s.」

641:t_016:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Now it all connects! Why $$ガドライト#pilot$$ burned with rage at you during the $$時獄戦役$$!」

641:t_016:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「He must have realized it. That I was one of the $$御使い$$s who destroyed his homeworld, $$ジェミナイ$$.」
